
CmdTimer = Timer.New()

CmdTime = .5

CmdTimer:Start(CmdTime)

function SndCmd()
  local StrLen = 1
  StrLen = cCmd and string.len(cCmd) or 0
  if StrLen > 2 then     
  Send(cCmd) 
  end
end 



CmdTimer.EventHandler = SndCmd



--[[

-- Example string of numbers
local numString = "12345"

-- Initialize an empty table (array)
local array = {}

-- Iterate over each character in the string
for i = 1, #numString do
    -- Convert the character to a number and insert into the table
    array[i] = tonumber(numString:sub(i, i))
end

-- Print the resulting array
for i = 1, #array do
    print(array[i])
end

local csv_string = "apple,orange,banana,grape"
local values = {}

for value in csv_string:gmatch("[^,]+") do
    table.insert(values, value)
end

-- Now 'values' table contains each value as separate elements
for i, v in ipairs(values) do
    print(i, v)
end

]]--

-- Specify the path to your HTML file
  local file_path = "help.htm"
  
  -- Open the file in read mode
  local file = io.open(file_path, "r")
  
  if file then
      -- Read the entire content of the file
      local content = file:read("*a")
      
      -- Output or process the content as needed
      print(content)

 -- Close the file handle
      file:close()
